content: Human-labeling session — lh-tech-pivot-attack:medium seed 1. Objective: Commander, your western base — Construction Yard, power plant, barracks, war factory, service depot and one scout jeep — spawns NORTH (y=10) or SOUTH (y=30) by seed. Two enemy headquarters hide at the east corners (NE and SE), one defended by rocket soldiers, one by medium tanks; composition flips per seed. Win bar: jeep reaches either eastern scout band (radius 10 around (80,5) or (80,36)), commit either four rocket soldiers OR a gun turret plus two medium tanks, and raze a yard, within about 85 turns.
